risk_if_not_implemented: Without Testing for Reliability & Integrity, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to protect data backup and restoration hardware and software.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection (BCD-31) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Testing for Reliability & Integrity (BCD-32) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Isolated Recovery Environment
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize an isolated, non-production environment to perform data backup and recovery operations through offline, cloud or off-site capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Isolated Recovery Environment (BCD-19) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Testing for Reliability & Integrity (BCD-32) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
